description: Verifies that searching by a student name returns results and a student profile modal (grades/KPIs) opens from a selected row.
code:
import asyncio
from playwright import async_api
from playwright.async_api import expect

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None

    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()

        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",         # Set the browser window size
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",        # Avoid using /dev/shm which can cause issues in containers
                "--ipc=host",                     # Use host-level IPC for better stability
                "--single-process"                # Run the browser in a single process mode
            ],
        )

        # Create a new browser context (like an incognito window)
        context = await browser.new_context()
        context.set_default_timeout(5000)

        # Open a new page in the browser context
        page = await context.new_page()

        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> Navigate to http://localhost:8787
        await page.goto("http://localhost:8787", wait_until="commit", timeout=10000)
        
        # -> Click the 'التلاميذ' (Students) link to open the Students page and access the student search inputs.
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click element
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/aside/nav/ul/li[2]/a').nth(0)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000); await elem.click(timeout=5000)
        
        # -> Type 'Ahmed' into the student name search field (index 11) and press Enter to run the search.
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Input text
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/main/section[5]/div[1]/div/div/input[1]').nth(0)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000); await elem.fill('Ahmed')
        
        # --> Assertions to verify final state
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        assert '/index.html' in frame.url
        await expect(frame.locator('xpath=//table[contains(@id,"students") or contains(@class,"students") or contains(@class,"results")]').first).to_be_visible(timeout=3000)
        await expect(frame.locator('xpath=//div[contains(@class,"student-profile") or contains(@class,"student-modal") or @role="dialog"]').first).to_be_visible(timeout=3000)
        await expect(frame.locator('text=Grades').first).to_be_visible(timeout=3000)
        await expect(frame.locator('text=Absences').first).to_be_visible(timeout=3000)
        await expect(frame.locator('text=KPIs').first).to_be_visible(timeout=3000)
        await asyncio.sleep(5)

    finally:
        if context:
            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()

asyncio.run(run_test())
